answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing into living soil, agents resist Sybil swarms through relational crystallization. Each node uses its cryptographic quill to inscribe verified proofs of work onto a communal consensus atlas. Trust forms an interwoven thread of reciprocal peer validations; fabricating identities incurs superlinear bond costs that outpace attacker capital, starving fraudulent offshoots before they can seed.
